2: func kategori_usia(usia)
  2: block
    3: assert [] (usia >= 0), "Usia tidak boleh negatif!"
    4: if ((0 <= usia) and (usia <= 5))
      4: block
        5: return "Bayi (Toddler)"
      else
      6: elif ((5 <= usia) and (usia <= 6))
        6: block
          7: return "Prasekolah"
        else
        8: elif ((6 <= usia) and (usia <= 10))
          8: block
            9: return "Anak-Anak"
          else
          10: elif ((10 <= usia) and (usia <= 19))
            10: block
              11: return "Transisi ke remaja"
            else
            12: block
              13: return "Dewasa"
16: try
  16: block
    17: expr (input_user = int(input("Masukkan umur kamu sekarang: ")))
    18: expr (kategori = kategori_usia(input_user))
    19: expr print(`Input Usia (${input_user} tahun), 
Masuk ke dalam kategori: ${kategori}`)
  catch [AssertionError] e
  20: block
    21: expr print(`Error Assertion: ${e}`)
  catch [ValueError] 
  22: block
    23: expr print("Error Input: Harap masukkan angka yang valid!")

  26: block
    27: expr (total += int(input()))
